第二天下午，虹桥机场。

黑色奥迪停在贵宾通道外侧，车窗降了一半。

航站楼里人来人往，行李箱滚轮刮过地砖，声音断断续续传出来。

沈蔓这班航班从厦门飞上海。

落地时间两点二十。

两点十八，林川手机亮了一下。

“落地啦。今天乘务长表扬我，说我广播比以前温柔。我怀疑她想让我多飞两段。”

林川回：“你本来就温柔。”

那边回得很快。

“林总今天嘴这么甜？项目签完了，心情好？”

“还行。”

“那我待会儿要敲诈你。”

“可以，上限五块。”

“抠门。”

林川收起手机，靠在车旁等。

这几天，他的时间被切成了碎片。

张江签约、齐家团队、顾城的情报、叶知秋送来的并表文件，每件事后面都有人等他拍板。

外人看他风光。

开会坐主位，出门有人接，账户上趴着大笔现金。

可真正落到日子里，就是一件事还没落地，另一件事已经堵到门口。

很多时候，他连一顿饭都吃不完整。

沈蔓出来时，穿着米色风衣，里面是针织衫，头发低低挽着，手里拖着银色小箱子。

她一出门就看见了林川。

脚步快了两下，又在他面前停住。

“林总亲自接机，排面给足了。”

林川接过箱子。

“沈小姐架子大，不来不行。”

沈蔓打量他两秒。

“瘦了。”

“有吗？”

“有。”她碰了下他的袖口，“下巴都利索了。你最近是不是又天天熬夜？”

“资本家熬夜，员工安心。”

“胡说，员工只会觉得老板命硬。”

林川把箱子放进后备厢。

沈蔓坐进副驾，系安全带时，转头看他。

“我听小冉说，你前几天又把北京来的大机构打回去了？”

“她消息这么灵？”

“小冉说学校里有人传她哥是上海滩新贵。我问她什么感觉，她说还行，主要是饭卡余额比较踏实。”

林川发动车。

“这孩子挺会抓重点。”

车子驶出机场。

沈蔓没有继续问那些大事。

她见过林川在饭局上的样子，也见过他一通电话让成都方锐低头，后来又听说副市长去了张江。

那些事离她原来的生活太远。

远到她拿回空姐宿舍说，别人只会觉得她在编故事。

但她能看见更细的地方。

林川接电话时，话越来越少。

有些名字一出口，旁边的人会主动放低声音。

他看文件的时候，整个人会从生活里抽出去。

可他来接她，还是会提前到。

还是会替她放箱子。

还是记得她不喜欢车里香水味太重。

车开上高架。

沈蔓从包里拿出一叠资料。

“我这次过来，还有件事跟你商量。”

“说。”

“我在老家已经买了一套房子。”

林川看了她一眼。

沈蔓把资料递过去。

“虹桥这边也有一套两居，离机场和航司基地都不远。装修能住，房东急着出国，价格比市场低一点。”

“想在上海买？”

The next afternoon, Hongqiao Airport.

The black Audi was parked outside the VIP channel with its windows lowered halfway.

People were coming and going in the terminal, and the sound of suitcase rollers scraping against the floor tiles could be heard intermittently.

Shen Man's flight was from Xiamen to Shanghai.

Landing time is 2:20.

At 2:18, Lin Chuan's phone lit up.

"We've landed. The flight attendant praised me today and said that my broadcast was gentler than before. I suspect she wanted me to fly two more stages."

Lin Chuan replied: "You are gentle by nature."

The response there was quick.

"Mr. Lin is so sweet today? The project has been signed. Are you in a good mood?"

"It's okay."

"Then I'm going to blackmail you later."

"Okay, the upper limit is five yuan."

"Stingy."

Lin Chuan put away his cell phone and leaned against the car to wait.

These days, his time has been cut into pieces.

Zhang Jiang's signing, the Qijia team, Gu Cheng's information, the consolidation documents sent by Ye Zhiqiu, there were people waiting for his decision behind everything.

Outsiders see his beauty.

I sit in the main seat at meetings, I’m picked up when I go out, and there’s a large amount of cash in my account.

But when it really comes down to the day, one thing has not yet come to fruition, and another thing has already blocked the door.

Many times, he couldn't even finish a meal.

When Shen Man came out, she was wearing a beige windbreaker with a knitted sweater underneath, her hair pulled down low, and she was dragging a small silver box in her hand.

She saw Lin Chuan as soon as she went out.

The steps quickened twice and then stopped in front of him.

"Mr. Lin personally picked up the plane, and the arrangements were sufficient."

Lin Chuan took the box.

"Miss Shen is so arrogant, I can't help but come."

Shen Man looked at him for two seconds.

"lost weight."

"Is there any?"

"Yes." She touched his cuffs, "My jaw feels sharp. Have you stayed up late every day again recently?"

“Capitalists stay up late and employees feel at ease.”

"Nonsense, employees will only think that the boss is tough."

Lin Chuan put the box into the trunk.

Shen Man got into the passenger seat and turned to look at him while fastening her seat belt.

"I heard from Xiaoran that you sent back a large organization from Beijing a few days ago?"

"Is she so well informed?"

"Xiao Ran said there was a rumor in school that her brother was a new rich man in Shanghai. I asked her how she felt, and she said it was okay, mainly because her meal card balance was relatively stable."

Lin Chuan started the car.

"This kid is very good at grasping key points."

The car drove out of the airport.

Shen Man did not continue to ask about those big things.

She had seen Lin Chuan's behavior at the dinner party, and had also seen him make Chengdu Fang Rui bow his head with a phone call. Later, she heard that the deputy mayor had gone to Zhangjiang.

Those things were too far away from her original life.

It was so far away that when she took it back to the stewardess dormitory, others would just think she was making up stories.

But she could see finer points.

When Lin Chuan answered the phone, he spoke less and less.

As soon as some names are spoken, the people next to you will take the initiative to lower their voices.

When he reads the document, he is withdrawn from life.

But when he came to pick her up, he would still arrive early.

I will still put the box for her.

I still remember that she didn’t like the strong smell of perfume in the car.

The car drove onto the elevated road.

Shen Man took out a stack of information from his bag.

"I'm here this time to discuss something with you."

"Say."

"I have already bought a house in my hometown."

Lin Chuan glanced at her.

Shen Man handed over the information.

"There is also a two-bedroom apartment here in Hongqiao, not far from the airport and airline base. The decoration is livable, and the landlord is eager to go abroad. The price is a little lower than the market."

"Want to buy in Shanghai?"
